function.name: compare_assets
function.description: Compare period returns across markets in one table: BIST/US stocks, gold, FX, crypto and TEFAS funds, in both TRY and USD.

assets.description: Assets to compare. Bare symbols are resolved automatically: BIST tickers (ASELS), US tickers (AAPL), FX and metals (USD, EUR, gram-altin, gram-gumus, BRENT), crypto pairs (BTCTRY, BTC-USD), TEFAS fund codes (TI2). If a symbol names an asset in two markets, the call fails and asks you to disambiguate.

start_date.description: Window start (YYYY-MM-DD). The entry price is the first session ON OR AFTER this date.

end_date.description: Window end (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today. The exit price is the last session on or before it.

base_currency.description: Currency the table is sorted by. Both TRY and USD returns are always reported.

initial_amount.description: If given, also report what this amount would have grown to, in both currencies.

compare_mode.description: Enable comparison mode for multiple funds

function.name: get_macro_data

data_type.description: Data type: 'inflation' for rates, 'calculate' for cumulative calculation

region.description: Region: 'tr' (TÜFE/ÜFE, TRY), 'us' (CPI-U, USD), 'eu' (HICP, EUR). US and EU publish a headline index only, so inflation_type does not apply there.

start_year.description: Start year for calculation mode (US series reaches back to 1913)

limit.description: Maximum data points for inflation data

function.name: get_evds_data
function.description: MACRO: TCMB EVDS - 145 categories, tens of thousands of macro series (rates, FX, balance of payments, inflation, expectation surveys). Use action to browse catalog, search, fetch series, or access dashboards. Catalog and search work without a key; data fetch (series, multi_series, datagroup_data) requires EVDS_API_KEY env var (free at https://evds3.tcmb.gov.tr). Required params by action: datagroups→category_id; series_list/datagroup_data→datagroup_code; search/search_server→keyword; series/series_info→series_code; multi_series→series_codes; dashboard→dashboard_name or dashboard_id.

action.description: EVDS operation. No key: categories, datagroups, series_list, search, search_server, series_info, dashboards. Key required: series, multi_series, datagroup_data, dashboard.

category_id.description: Numeric category ID for action='datagroups'. Get IDs from action='categories'.

lang.description: Language for client-side search titles (TR or EN).

series_code.description: EVDS series code for action='series' or 'series_info'.

series_codes.description: List of EVDS series codes for action='multi_series' (max 20).

period.description: Time period. Ignored when start_date is provided.

start_date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Overrides 'period' when set.

end_date.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Optional with start_date.

frequency.description: Resampling frequency. Defaults to series native frequency.

aggregation.description: Aggregation method when resampling. Defaults to series default.

formula.description: Transformation: raw level, pct_change, year-over-year %, moving avg, etc.

decimals.description: Number of decimal places in returned values (0-6).

dashboard_id.description: Dashboard encoded ID (base64-like string) for action='dashboard', alternative to dashboard_name. Get IDs from action='dashboards'.

limit.description: Max observations / records returned per series (payload safety cap). Default 100 keeps responses compact; raise it (max 5000) only when long history is genuinely needed.
